This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Augmented Software Engineer [gn] Data Intelligence Platform based in Germany.

This is an opportunity for a full-stack engineer to help build a modern data intelligence platform that enables organisations to discover, govern, and trust their data.
You’ll work end-to-end across backend services and frontend experiences, taking features from initial concept through production delivery.
AI coding assistants will be a core part of your engineering toolkit, helping you accelerate development while keeping human judgment at the center of technical decisions.
You’ll contribute to scalable SaaS products where correctness, security, performance, and maintainability are critical.
The role offers significant autonomy, encouraging you to identify problems, shape solutions, and move initiatives forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
You’ll collaborate closely with product managers and engineers in an agile, feedback-driven environment focused on continuous improvement.
It’s an ideal setting for a pragmatic builder who wants to multiply their engineering impact through thoughtful use of AI.


Accountabilities
  • Design and implement full-stack product features across backend services and frontend interfaces, ensuring strong performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of features from understanding requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools deliberately to accelerate development, reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, improve test coverage, and increase engineering leverage.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment when using AI-generated output, reviewing, validating, and improving solutions rather than relying on automation without oversight.
  • Participate actively in technical design discussions and code reviews, promoting clean architecture, secure development practices, and testable code.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and participate in incident response, taking shared responsibility for the stability and reliability of the platform.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand customer and business requirements early and translate them into clear, achievable technical solutions.
  • Share technical knowledge with colleagues through documentation, technical sessions, and internal development practices.
  • Help establish and improve AI-assisted engineering practices, contributing reusable approaches, workflows, and lessons learned across the team.
  • Contribute to an agile working environment based on short feedback loops, iterative delivery, collaboration, and continuous learning.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven professional experience as a full-stack software engineer, with a track record of independently building and shipping production features in SaaS environments.
    • Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools as an integrated part of your development workflow.

    • Practical experience with Scala or Java on the backend and TypeScript and Angular on the frontend is highly valuable; expertise across every technology is not required, but you should be willing and able to grow across the stack.
    • Solid understanding of SaaS architecture and cloud fundamentals, particularly within AWS environments.
    • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
    • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including clean architecture, testing, maintainability, performance, and secure development.
    • A genuine agile mindset, with a preference for iterative delivery, rapid feedback, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
    • Strong product thinking and the ability to translate business and user requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
    • Comfortable working with autonomy, taking initiative, and driving work forward without requiring every task to be explicitly assigned.
    • Strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills within collaborative engineering teams.

    • Experience with data governance, data catalogs, metadata management, or data intelligence platforms is a significant advantage.

Intro

Back problems are the most common cause of work incapacity in Germany.

Vivira has the solution: We provide digital movement therapy via app. Always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Vivira was born out of the need to treat musculoskeletal conditions as simply and effectively as possible.


Your responsibilities include

As Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/f/d), you play a central role in developing and expanding our existing digital therapy offering. 

You drive forward how we can support patients and physicians even better in treating and reducing musculoskeletal pain. Depending on your experience and current focus, you take ownership of a central product or growth area along our patient, therapy, or practice journey – acting as the interface between medical relevance, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and commercial success. 

You conceive, validate, and prioritize new product and service ideas and prepare them for implementation in a structured way. Your work lays the foundation for expanding our product and service portfolio, strengthens long-term customer relationships, and creates lasting value – beyond the actual therapy phase.


What you should bring

  • Experience: Several years of solid product management experience (typically 5+ years), e.g. as Senior, Lead, or Principal Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in Digital Health, MedTech, DiGA, or similar fields. You have independently owned a digital product area and can show how your decisions changed user and business outcomes.
  • Outcome-driven product development: You steer by impact, not output – data-driven decisions come naturally to you.
  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership: You communicate confidently with C-level, Engineering, Regulatory, and the clinical team.
  • Mindset: You bring strong empathy for the medical context, act proactively, and have a solution-oriented, hands-on mentality.
  • AI fluency: You use AI pragmatically in discovery, research, analysis, or prototyping and can judge where it accelerates product work – and where human judgement remains essential.
  • Language: Excellent German and English (C1 or above in both) – neither needs to be your native language.

Nice to have
  • Experience in Healthcare, Digital Health, HealthTech, MedTech, Pharma, Digital Therapeutics, or Clinical Software – ideally with direct DiGA experience and knowledge of the regulatory framework (DiGA, MDR).
  • Experience working with physicians, practice teams, medical assistants, patients, or other healthcare stakeholders.


What to expect at Vivira

  • Workplace: Work from home or from our centrally located Berlin HQ.
  • Working abroad: The option to work remotely for up to one month per year from the EU, EEA, Switzerland, Israel, or the UK.
  • Recharge: 30 vacation days – for real breaks and new energy.
  • Health: Mobility and back strength directly from us to you – digital support you can use yourself.
  • Secure your future: Build for tomorrow today with an increased employer contribution to your pension plan.
  • Corporate benefits: Enjoy exclusive advantages for shopping, tech, and more.
  • Referral bonus: Sharing your network pays off – every successful referral is rewarded.
  • Highlights: Several company and team events per year create exchange, fun, and a real sense of community.

Bei Juit ermöglichen wir unseren Kunden, sich jeden Tag gesund zu ernähren, indem wir von Köchen und Köchinnen zubereitete Mahlzeiten direkt nach Hause liefern.   • Du hast eine offene, mitreißende Persönlichkeit und absolut keine Scheu, fremde Menschen aktiv anzusprechen.

Unser Versprechen

data.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Operations Lead to partner with the leadership team of one of Superhuman’s Business Units (BUs) to drive strategic clarity, operational alignment, and execution across the BU’s most important initiatives. Our BUs are led by an Engineering, Product, Design, and Marketing (EPDM) leadership team — with the Product leader as the point of the spear — and this role exists to make that BU and its leadership team successful as we expand our product portfolio in a compound-startup model.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and cross-functional execution. You will solid-line into the Strategy & Operations organization and dotted-line into your Business Unit, giving you both a durable operating craft and deep proximity to the leaders you serve. You’ll turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans, closing the gap between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution as a permanent operational partner to the team — not a project manager cycling through initiatives with a wind-down date. Your partners in this effort will span the company from other BUs to our Route-to-Market (RTM) teams and functional experts. It is truly an opportunity to have an outsized impact!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with your BU’s EPDM leadership team — anchored by the Product leader as the point of the spear — to turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans.

  • Plan and Track: run team-level planning, goal-setting, business reviews, and performance tracking connected to company-wide planning cycles, so leaders can focus on decision-making.

  • Special Projects: take dedicated ownership of the BU’s most complex, cross-functional initiatives so key efforts have a clear owner and don’t stall.

  • Ways of Working: build the rhythms, cadences, documentation, and tooling, so the team isn’t rebuilding its operating infrastructure from scratch each quarter or with each reorg.

  • Leadership Extension: represent your leaders in forums, cross-company meetings, and escalation paths as a trusted delegate — not just a coordinator — so key decisions don’t wait on calendar openings.

  • Partner across the company with other BUs, Route-to-Market (RTM) teams, and functional experts to have an outsize impact on the trajectory of our organization.

  • Facilitate strong information flow up, across, and down the organization to enable fast, informed decision-making in a matrixed, multi-product environment.

  • Drive operational readiness for new products, integrations, and cross-functional launches by coordinating planning and enablement across the BU and its RTM partners.

  • Independently drive initiatives day-to-day while scoping and partnering with the broader Strategy & Operations team for support on key motions.

Example Impact:

  • Establish a clear operating cadence, planning rhythms, business review, and governance model, dashboards, etc. for the BU to drive visibility, accountability, and faster decisions.

  • Take ownership of one or more of the BU’s most complex initiatives — for example, a cross-functional launch or the integration of an acquired product or team — and see it through.

  • Define and track success metrics for the BU, linking operational outcomes to company goals.

Qualifications

  • Experience operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, and cross-functional execution, especially in complex go-to-market or enterprise growth environments.

  • A strong track record partnering with senior leaders across EPDM, GTM, Revenue, Sales, Finance, and Data to align priorities and turn strategy into execution.

  • Proven skill in building operating cadences, governance models, planning rhythms, and decision-making processes that improve clarity, accountability, and speed.

  • The ability to lead through influence in a matrixed, multi-product organization, acting as a connective operator across teams and business units.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous, high-impact initiatives independently, using data-informed judgment to drive readiness, launches, and business performance.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a matrixed organization.

  • Executive presence.

  • M&A and acquisition-integration experience.

  • Financial acumen.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

     

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. Enterprise conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful without a Solutions Engineer in the room. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and close new, complex opportunities, engage with technical and nontechnical stakeholders to accelerate the sales process. Understand and align with each customer's product, business, and compliance roadmap to uncover opportunities for Notabene to accelerate their progress against it

  • Over time hire, help provide input and hire 1-2 additional Solutions Architecture team, and be a vocal advocate for the SA function across the organization.

  • Recommend and develop systems and processes for the Solutions Architecture team that can be used to fit into the broader pre-sales GTM team and strategy, including but not limited to proposing metrics to measure the performance and impact of the Solutions Architecture team

  • Support in the design and development of exemplary POC and act as the escalation point for pre-sales technical issues

  • Align with GTM leaders to spot market trends and channel those insights back to Notabene's leadership and product teams

  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing and other teams such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and Product Engineering, to build joint go-to-market initiatives that improve customer outcomes, driving revenue and growth

  • Bring strong executive engagement skills and presence, establishing credible relationships with prospects’ decision-makers

  • Maintain strong internal relationships with Product and Engineering, championing the voice of our customers and their compliance teams to influence roadmap direction and feature priorities

Qualifications

  • 2+ year of pre-sales leadership experience, with a proven ability to build, coach, and retain high-performing teams;

  • 5+ years across technical sales, consulting, implementation, or go-to-market functions;

  • A track record of building and leading world-class Solutions Architecture/Sales Engineering/Solutions Engineering teams, ideally in a SaaS business

  • Genuine energy, curiosity, and a passion for making customers successful, and creatively drafting solutions to address customers’ needs

  • Strong hands-on technical sales experience with APIs;

  • Knowledge of payments, crypto, fintech, or RegTech industry experience strongly preferred

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build deep, credible relationships with our prospects and customers

data.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote, within EMEA time zones.

The impact you will have:

At Notabene, the success of our customers drives everything that we do, and our Customer Success team is at the heart of that. You will own a book of customers across EMEA, from crypto-native exchanges and payment providers through to the financial institutions and fintechs now launching digital asset products.

Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them. The commercial conversation sits with you, which means renewals, pricing and upsells are yours to run.

You are also a technical point of contact for your customers. These conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Within a year you are successful if…

  • Net retention across your book has grown, and you can name the renewals and upsells that did it

  • Your customers are live and using the product, and the ones at risk were identified early

  • You have found and qualified upsell opportunities inside your existing customers, and converted a good number of them

  • Customers come to you first, on their compliance programme and on their commercial relationship with us

  • You can demonstrate real knowledge of our product and of the wider industry

What you will be doing:

  • Owning the post-sales journey for your customers: onboarding, adoption, business reviews, renewal and upsell

  • Running your own renewals and upsells, including pricing and the conversation with the economic buyer

  • Guiding customers through their Travel Rule programmes and their stablecoin payment products

  • Working directly with customer integration teams: API documentation, test calls, transaction and webhook data, and a clear diagnosis when something is stuck

  • Monitoring usage, engagement and risk signals, and acting on them with a clear plan well before they become a renewal problem

  • Finding growth inside your existing customers across adjacent teams, entities and products, and working with Sales on the net-new ones

  • Building relationships across compliance, operations and engineering, so the relationship never rests on one contact

  • Bringing customer and competitor insight back to product, sales and marketing

  • Keeping records current in HubSpot

  • Some on-call duty outside office hours

What you bring:

  • Based in EMEA, able to cover customers across the region

  • Around 5 years in Customer Success or Account Management at a crypto, fintech or regtech SaaS company, or in another complex technical market, managing your own book of customers

  • Commercial ownership. You have run your own renewals and upsells and negotiated pricing, without passing the deal back to Sales

  • Some technical range. You can work through API documentation, read a request and response, and form a view on why an integration is behaving the way it is

  • Experience across a mix of customers, from mid-market through to enterprise

  • Experience across the full lifecycle, from onboarding through to expansion

  • Exposure to compliance-driven or regulated environments

  • A doer. You own the detail yourself, and you move without waiting for a process to exist

  • Good judgement with people and real interest in solving their problems

  • Comfortable working autonomously and getting stuck in

Nice to Have

  • Travel Rule, stablecoin payments or digital asset compliance experience

  • Experience with banks and regulated financial institutions entering digital assets

  • Having built Customer Success processes and playbooks from scratch

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology.

 

What You Will Do

  • Shape high-impact AI transformations

    • Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in the UK & Nordics to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement.

    • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify where frontier AI can create material business value.

    • Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs.

    • Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans.

    • Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability.

  • Sponsor Mistral’s most strategic deliveries

    • Act as a senior sponsor on the largest and most complex customer programs, primarily in the UK & Nordics and potentially cross-region as priorities evolve.

    • Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact.

    • Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

    • Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified.

  • Build repeatable deployment excellence

    • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns.

    • Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled.

    • Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution.

    • Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI.

    • Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases.

    • Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution.

  • Develop and multiply senior DS impact

    • Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership.

    • Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities.

    • Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities.

    • Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work.

Typical indicators we’re looking for include:

  • 8–10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment.

  • Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context.

  • A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution.

  • Experience leading large accounts, complex programs, or senior customer relationships.

  • The credibility to engage with executives and C-level stakeholders on business priorities, trade-offs, and impact.

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Comfort working at the frontier of technology, even when solutions are evolving quickly and the path is not fully defined.

  • A low-ego, high-ownership mindset and a desire to build with customers and teams, not just advise from a distance.

  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus.

 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you. 

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.


To help fuel that growth, we need a Rust Engineer to join our dynamic teams. 
 
This team is the beating heart of Prima. 
 
You’ll be joining over +350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance.
 
Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What you’ll do
  • Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable and consistent services, writing reusable, modular, and maintainable code aligned with industry best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders, product managers, and engineering managers to translate business requirements into effective software solutions, define timelines, and estimate effort.
  • Perform code reviews, enforce coding standards, troubleshoot and debug complex issues, and ensure high code quality and performance.
  • Stay up to date with new technologies and tools, drive their adoption when appropriate, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and team growth.

    • What we’re looking for
  • Extensive experience in backend development, with solid knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and domain-driven design.
  • Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable, with strong problem-solving skills and a growth mindset.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.

    • Nice-to-Have
  • Good knowledge of functional programming languages.
  • Professional experience with Rust and/or Elixir.
  • First-hand experience of test-driven development (TDD), Event-Sourcing and CQRS.
  • Experience with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
    •  
    Why you’ll love it here:
     
    We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.
     
    🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

    🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

    🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

    Think you’re a match? Apply now.

     

    At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

TALA has been on a rocket ship since its founding in 2019 by entrepreneur Grace Beverley. Built on largely organic social, today we are a digital-first, multichannel women’s activewear brand with a multifaceted growth and retention strategy.

Following a £5m fundraise from world-class institutional investors and growing global media attention, TALA is entering an exciting new phase of growth, including the opening of two stores in London.

Now, we’re taking TALA beyond London, and Bicester Village, you’re next.

*This will be for a FTC from November 26 to January 27*

Tasks

What you'll be doing

Goods In & Stock Flow

  • Own the end-to-end flow of stock from delivery to shop floor, taking full accountability for backroom performance.
  • Plan and manage delivery days around Bicester Village's service yard access and delivery windows, ensuring the team is resourced and ready ahead of every drop.
  • Receive, check and book in all deliveries accurately and on the day of arrival, escalating discrepancies, shortages and damages to Logistics within agreed timeframes.
  • Set and hold a clear delivery-to-floor turnaround standard

Processing, Pricing & Retail Ready

  • Own the "retail ready" standard end to end: steamed, sized, hung or folded, correctly hangered, security tagged, ticketed and floor-ready before it leaves the stockroom.
  • Manage the outlet pricing and ticketing process with total accuracy, ensuring every unit carries the correct price and any was/now ticketing is applied in line with brand and regulatory guidelines.
  • Execute promotional changes, markdowns and price changes to deadline, including overnight or pre-trade implementation where needed.
  • Build simple, repeatable processing routines and workstation set-ups that let the team move at volume without losing accuracy.
  • Track and improve processing productivity, using units-per-hour measures to plan labour and forecast the resource needed for peak drops.

Stock Accuracy & Inventory Integrity

  • Be the store's owner of stock file accuracy, treating the integrity of our data as a core deliverable rather than an admin task.
  • Run a disciplined cycle counting programme across the store, prioritising high-value, high-volume and known problem lines.
  • Investigate and resolve negative stock, unknown barcodes, duplicate barcodes and mis-scanning patterns, feeding root causes back to HQ rather than simply correcting the symptom.
  • Lead the store's preparation for and execution of full stocktakes, including pre-count housekeeping, team briefing, counting discipline and post-count exception resolution.
  • Own shrinkage performance for the store alongside the Store Manager, identifying loss drivers and putting practical controls in place.

Replenishment & Trading Support

  • Ensure the shop floor is fully sized and replenished at open, through the day and at close, so we never lose a sale to a size sitting in a box.
  • Partner with the Store Manager on floor moves, launches and campaign execution, making sure stock is available in the right quantity at the right moment.
  • Provide the Store Manager and Merchandising with clear, timely feedback on size and line performance, sell-through, over-stocks and gaps.
  • Support omnichannel fulfilment activity in store, including click and collect and any in-store fulfilment we introduce, to the service levels we set.

Backroom Management & Space

  • Design and maintain a stockroom layout that works at volume: logical, labelled, densely but safely stored, and quick to pick from.
  • Manage stockroom capacity actively, flagging space risk ahead of major intakes and working with HQ on solutions before it becomes a trading problem.
  • Own backroom housekeeping, packaging management, waste and recycling, in line with TALA's sustainability commitments.
  • Keep all equipment, consumables and ticketing supplies stocked and functioning.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the stockroom team, building a small operation that takes genuine pride in pace, accuracy and standards.
  • Own rota planning for the backroom team, matching labour to the delivery schedule and trading peaks within payroll budget.
  • Recruit, onboard and train new team members on all BOH processes, and build stockroom capability across the wider store team.
  • Set clear daily targets and priorities, and hold the team to them through visible, on-the-floor leadership.

Compliance, Safety & Deputising

  • Ensure health and safety compliance across all back of house areas, including manual handling, safe stacking, fire exits and equipment checks, with regular audits and documented training.
  • Embed loss prevention procedures across goods in, stockroom and waste routines.
  • Ensure the store meets all Bicester Village centre operating standards and requirements.
  • Act as a key holder, opening and closing the store, and deputise for the Store Manager in their absence - including on trade, service and team decisions.

Requirements

About you:

  • Experience in a retail environment, preferably in fashion, activewear, or wellness—but above all, a genuine passion for these areas is a must.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, allowing you to connect effortlessly with customers and inspire your team.
  • A natural problem-solver—proactive, quick to learn, and able to thrive both independently and as part of a dynamic team.
  • Strong visual merchandising instincts, with a keen eye for detail to keep the store looking stylish and on-brand at all times.
  • Excellent multitasking skills, balancing customer service, sales, and store operations seamlessly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking) to ensure clear and engaging customer interactions.
  • Passionate about building customer relationships, from discussing upcoming collections to gathering customer insights that foster long-term loyalty.

Benefits

Some of our core benefits include:

  • 28 days holiday a year inclusive of bank holidays
  • You'll be automatically enrolled in our company pension scheme with Aviva
  • Employee discount after probation period
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • TALA Uniform

About us

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Read about TALA's people, purpose and product work here.

data.title: Retail Store Operations Manager - Bicester Village

data.description:
TALA has been on a rocket ship since its founding in 2019 by entrepreneur Grace Beverley. Built on largely organic social, today we are a digital-first, multichannel women’s activewear brand with a multifaceted growth and retention strategy.

Following a £5m fundraise from world-class institutional investors and growing global media attention, TALA is entering an exciting new phase of growth, including the opening of two stores in London.

Now, we’re taking TALA beyond London, and Bicester Village, you’re next.

*This will be for a FTC from November 26 to January 27*

Tasks

What you'll be doing

Commercial Performance

  • Take full ownership of your store's commercial performance, with accountability for sales, payroll, controllable costs and contribution.
  • Trade the store daily and weekly: read the numbers, identify the opportunity, brief the team and act on it.
  • Use conversion, ATV, AOV, UPT, footfall and sell-through data to drive decisions rather than describe outcomes.
  • Build and manage the store rota to maximise the trading day, matching labour to footfall patterns within payroll budget.
  • Set clear individual and team targets, and create a culture where the team understands and cares about the numbers.
  • Identify and escalate commercial risks and opportunities to the Head of Retail, with a proposed solution.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, onboard and retain a high-performing store team, building a bench of talent rather than filling vacancies reactively.
  • Coach and develop every member of the team through regular one-to-ones, structured feedback and on-the-floor coaching.
  • Manage performance directly and fairly, addressing underperformance early and recognising strong performance visibly.
  • Develop your Supervisors and Store Operations Manager toward the next level, and own succession planning for your store.
  • Lead training on product, service, systems and brand, and make sure new starters are properly set up to succeed.
  • Create a culture of ownership and pride where every colleague understands their role in the commercial and brand outcome.

Customer Experience & Brand

  • Champion a best-in-class customer experience, ensuring every interaction reflects TALA's tone of voice, values and community.
  • Set and hold the service standard personally — you should be the best example of it in the building.
  • Handle escalated customer issues, complaints and returns with judgement and care.
  • Use customer feedback, team insight and floor observation to continually improve the in-store journey, and feed that insight back to HQ.
  • Build genuine community in your local market, supporting events, partnerships and activations that bring people into the store.

Visual Merchandising & Trading the Floor

  • Deliver visual merchandising standards in line with brand and marketing briefs, executing launches and campaigns to a high standard and to deadline.
  • Trade the floor commercially, adjusting layout and product placement in response to performance while staying true to brand guidelines.
  • Maintain immaculate store standards at all times: presentation, cleanliness, fitting rooms, music, lighting and front of house.

Stock & Store Operations

  • Hold overall accountability for stock in your store, including stock accuracy, shrinkage and stocktake results.
  • Partner with your Store Operations Manager on delivery flow, processing, pricing accuracy, replenishment and backroom standards - they own the execution, you own the outcome.
  • Work with Merchandising and Logistics on intake, consolidation, transfers and range feedback for your store.
  • Ensure cash handling, banking, POS and daily operational routines are completed accurately and securely.
  • Implement and embed the TALA Retail Playbook consistently, and feed back where it can be improved.

Communication & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as the link between your store and HQ, ensuring clear, timely communication in both directions.
  • Work with HQ teams including Merchandising, Operations and Logistics, Finance, People and Marketing on weekly and monthly reporting packs, trade feedback and store input.
  • Represent your team in cross-functional conversations, bringing commercial insight, customer feedback and operational reality to the table.
  • Deliver accurate, on-time reporting and respond to HQ requests within agreed timeframes.

Compliance & Safety

  • Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations by implementing and maintaining store safety protocols, conducting regular audits and training the team to uphold a safe environment for both employees and customers.
  • Ensure the store meets all landlord, centre and legal operating requirements.
  • Embed loss prevention and security procedures across the team.

What we're looking for

  • Proven store management experience in activewear, fashion or lifestyle retail, ideally in a premium or fast-growth brand.
  • A track record of delivering against sales, payroll and profitability targets.
  • Genuine commerciality — you can read a P&L and a trade report and know what to do next.
  • Strong people leadership: a proven recruiter, coach and developer of retail talent.
  • A proven record of delivering excellent customer service, and the standards to hold others to it.
  • A strong understanding of brand visual identity and how to translate it to the shop floor.
  • Confident communicator, comfortable influencing both a shop floor team and senior stakeholders.
  • Solid operational grounding across stock management, systems, cash handling and compliance.
  • A problem solver and self-starter who is comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-growing business that is learning as it goes.
  • Flexibility to support weekends, key trading moments and new store openings.
  • A genuine passion for TALA, our product and our community.

Requirements

About you:

  • Experience in a retail environment, preferably in fashion, activewear, or wellness—but above all, a genuine passion for these areas is a must.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, allowing you to connect effortlessly with customers and inspire your team.
  • A natural problem-solver—proactive, quick to learn, and able to thrive both independently and as part of a dynamic team.
  • Strong visual merchandising instincts, with a keen eye for detail to keep the store looking stylish and on-brand at all times.
  • Excellent multitasking skills, balancing customer service, sales, and store operations seamlessly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking) to ensure clear and engaging customer interactions.
  • Passionate about building customer relationships, from discussing upcoming collections to gathering customer insights that foster long-term loyalty.

Benefits

Some of our core benefits include:

  • 28 days holiday a year inclusive of bank holidays
  • You'll be automatically enrolled in our company pension scheme with Aviva
  • Employee discount after probation period
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • TALA Uniform

About us

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

data.title: Microsoft Solution Architect / Technical Lead - Contract role

data.description:
Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

  • Feature conceptualization. Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.
  • Requirements engineering. Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.
  • Sprint operations. Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.
  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.
  • Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.
  • Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Nice to have

Agile/Scrum exposure, ticket systems, manual QA or test-case experience, and an interest in music, education or marketplaces.

Benefits

  • Work directly with the VP Product in a dynamic, cross-functional team spanning Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Full end-to-end exposure: discovery, requirements, delivery, release, measurement and growth.
  • A front-row seat at Europe's leading music education platform, with real breadth across very different product challenges.
  • A modern, AI-first working culture.
  • A high-visibility talent role with direct exposure to the leadership team and an attractive international career trajectory as we scale.

We run a short, structured screening built around real examples of your work and how you think. Tell us who you are, why this role, and when you can start. We will take it from there.

  • Start: 15 September 2026

data.description:
Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. Every permanent team member gets equity, so when we grow, you do too. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership.

Big tech impact, without the big tech ick.


This role exists to unlock technical value for Mitti’s customers by designing and delivering scalable integrations. It bridges the gap between Go-to-Market (GTM) and Product, Design & Engineering (PDE) to accelerate time-to-value within defined scope, timeline, and budget.


About You

  • Technical Expertise: You have strong hands-on experience with SQL, relational databases, APIs, enterprise integration patterns, and scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang).

  • Language & Communication: You possess full written and verbal fluency in French, with a proven ability to explain complex technical concepts effortlessly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

  • AI Leverage: You fluently use AI coding assistants and automation tools to accelerate spec drafting, data analysis, and code development securely.

  • Mindset & Approach: You are a self-directed, customer-first problem solver who context-switches easily, balances standard methodologies with edge-case judgment, and prioritises team success.

How Will I Spend My Time?

  • Delivering Technical Solutions: Scoping, designing, building, testing, and handing off standard integration and automation projects end-to-end within defined timelines and budgets.

  • Partnering Across GTM & Engineering: Collaborating with Account Executives during pre-sales, joining forces with CSMs and Onboarding Managers to accelerate deployment, and bridging customer feedback to Product, Design & Engineering to shape the roadmap.

  • Building Scalable Tooling: Identifying recurring technical patterns to build shared scripts, templates, and automations that reduce delivery effort across all customer accounts.

  • Managing Scope & Architecture: Advising customers on sustainable system architecture, managing package boundaries, and escalating custom requirements effectively.

At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through:

  • Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary,

  • Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility,

  • Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns;

  • We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies.

You'll also receive other perks such as:

  • In-house Culinary Crew serving up daily breakfast, lunch and snacks

  • Wellbeing initiatives such as subsidised fitness programs, EAP services and generous parental leave policy

  • Quarterly celebrations and team events

  • Table tennis, board games, gym sessions, book club, and pet-friendly offices.

We’re committed to building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging so our people can bring their whole authentic selves to work each day. We seek to make reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process to create an even playing field for all candidates. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the entire Mitti team we’ve built an incredible culture which has seen us recognised as a Best Place to Work in Australia , the US and the UK .

Even if you don't meet every requirement listed in the ad, please consider applying for this role. We prioritise inclusion and value individuals with potential over a checklist of qualifications. Don't rule yourself out, hit that apply button if this job resonates with you

You can find out more about life at Mitti via Youtube , Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn.

To all recruitment agencies, we do not accept resumes or partnership opportunities. Please do not forward resumes to Mitti or any of our employees. We are not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

data.title: Senior Customer Success Engineer, French Speaking

data.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Handle support requests from the business, providing data protection advice.

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, legal and security teams to ensure our products meet data protection regulations, best practices and client requirements.

  • Engage with our developers to advocate for privacy by design and default; embed privacy requirements into engineering workflows and the SDLC.

  • Conduct and support DPIAs and PIAs for products and processing activities, including risk mitigation and risk register management.

  • Supporting client delivery teams in answering data protection processing/handling queries, RFPs and audits.

  • Third-party vendor due diligence, working with InfoSec, Legal, and Procurement to assess vendor posture and manage subprocessor obligations.

  • Lead on data privacy incident response, including logging, investigation, root cause analysis, remediation, and regulatory and client reporting.

  • Develop and deliver training and knowledge content on global data protection.

  • Create and maintain data protection policies and procedures, automating workflows where possible - including through scripting and tooling, for efficient, scalable operations.

  • Maintaining record of processing activities for our controller and processor obligations, including data mapping across Kraken and our subsidiaries.

  • Managing the privacy mailbox, including handling rights requests.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party

Proven experience in the following:

Core requirement:

  • Data incident management, incl. root cause analysis, remediation, logging and reporting.

  • Significant operational experience in DPIAs/PIAs, third party vendor management, and risk management.

  • Creating and maintaining records of processing activities.

  • Working closely with technical/engineering teams, including software development and information security.

  • Working knowledge of the GDPR and UK DPA 2018 and staying current with the evolving data protection landscape.

  • Working in a Privacy Analyst role within an organisation that’s a data processor (e.g. a SaaS provider or software vendor).

  • Implementing Privacy by Design and Privacy by Default into product development.

  • Strong stakeholder management; confident engaging regularly with the business to support early and efficient risk analysis including over calls.

  • Strong written and verbal communication - ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • A self-starter, taking the initiative to help drive the team’s initiatives forward.

  • Highly adaptable to new technologies, processes, and changing priorities.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.

  • Very well organised; attention to detail and documentation, and being able to meet deadlines under pressure.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience automating privacy processes or workflows; scripting experience or working with APIs/MCPs to automate processes. Candidates with a privacy engineering background, or those looking to move into privacy engineering, are encouraged to apply.

  • Familiarity with privacy-enhancing technologies including data masking, pseudonymisation, anonymisation, and encryption at rest and in transit.

  • Experience with data discovery and classification tooling, and the ability to map data flows technically as well as through process-based exercises.

  • Familiarity with the SDLC and CI/CD environments.

  • Knowledge of privacy laws and local state requirements in EU, USA, APAC and the Middle East.

  • Familiarity with legislation affecting our global energy and utility clients and the associated implications for Kraken.

  • Understanding AI use cases within tech organisations and the associated data protection and privacy risks.

Soft Skills:

  • A self-starter, taking the initiative to help drive the team’s initiatives forward.
